Assault select-other result menu freeze — client static evidence + runtime log
Date: 2026-10-21 (Asia/Shanghai)
Client: DNF_SEASON4_OB_V31.0.24.0_Full/ARAD.exe (V31.0.24.0 client install; identified by SHA256 below)
Client SHA256: 7560188d4bac4a33690fe3b37069f365885f7f57e14cee868b64103852f28471
32-bit PE, file offset = VA - 0x400000; disassembly produced by capstone (CS_MODE_32) from the bytes above.
Server source baseline: fix/channel-town-entry 9142be6 (worktree <workspace>/worktrees/assault, branch fix/assault-clear-menu)
Runtime log: <workspace>/.tmp-build/combined-deploy/Logs/server.jsonl (live server merge ff337ed, PID 41296)

Conclusions (static + runtime):
1. Click on F11/F12 calls 039EBBB0(option, state=1) -> C2S72 (opcode 0x48) body state:u8, option:u8.
2. ACK72 success -> 02334F60 -> default module branch -> 039F7FC0(option,state): writes ResultUI +0x730=option, +0x734=state;
   state==1 stores +0x754=option (039F82DB), shows a system message (push 0x1DF=dstr479 / 0x1E0=dstr480 visible below),
   then writes +0x790 (dword) and +0x794 (byte) at 039F850F/039F8515.
3. 039F42F3: while +0x734==1 the ResultUI skips all button processing, so further F11/F12 clicks send nothing.
4. ACK15 success (02348ED0) jumps straight to the epilogue: a success ACK15 is a client no-op ("selector wake" does nothing).
5. The only exit observed: NOTI24 while module id==3 -> 023DF33E calls current module vtable+0xAC(4,0) -> SetState(4);
   01E0E850 state 4 -> 01E0D400, which reads ResultUI option (+0x754 via 039EC2F0): option 0 -> C2S15(dungeon)+C2S16,
   option 1 -> (party leader) C2S15(u32 0), else -> town module switch. Then state 5.
6. Runtime (UTC+8 2026-10-21): 00:58:00.95 recv 72 0101 -> send ACK72 010101 + ACK15 01 (formal_result_selector_wake);
   no further client 72/15/16 packet for ~43 s (only CHARACTER_STATISTIC right before the ESC giveup 42 at 00:58:43), which got NOTI3 + NOTI24 and the client left the result page.
7. Same log: 1.4 s after the giveup NOTI24 the client sent C2S15 00000000 and the server's normal selection (ACK15 + NOTI3 state1
   + NOTI27) opened map select. This is INCONCLUSIVE for the 01E0D400 option-1 leader path: earlier mid-dungeon giveups in the
   same session (00:56:39 -> 15(0) at 00:56:40.96, 00:57:07 -> 00:57:08.91) show the same quick 15(0) without a stored
   result option, and the town landing (54/2 1080,286) sits at the dungeon gate.
Unproven: the fixed sequence (ACK72 010101 + NOTI3 state0 + NOTI24) on the real client; whether a solo character passes the party-leader check in 01E0D400 (0x2D90E80 == 0x2D97860); real-machine run needed.
